newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX sets initial margins for Alberta gas futures.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX sets initial margins for Alberta gas futures.

text.p: The New York Mercantile Exchange said it established initial margins for its new Alberta natural gas futures contract which will be launched Friday.
The rates will be $1,000 for clearing members; $1,100 for members; and $1,350 for customers.
For inter-month spreads involving the spot month, the rates will be $250 for clearing members; $275 for members; and $338 for customers.
For inter-month spreads involving all other months, the rates will be $200 for clearing members; $220 for members; and $270 for customers.
Margins are good faith deposits to cover adverse price movements.
